text: 1、市场全天探底回升，三大指数集体调整。MLCC概念逆势走强，双星新材、风华高科涨停。PCB概念股表现活跃，崇达技术、超声电子、协和电子等涨停。军工板块盘中拉升，内蒙一机、银河电子涨停。下跌方面，大金融板块下挫，新力金融、翠微股份跌停，锦龙股份接近跌停。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市近4900股飘绿，今日成交1.99万亿。截止收盘沪指跌1.18%，深成指跌1.08%，创业板指跌0.49%。 2、板块概念方面，MLCC、军工、铜高速连接、影视等板块涨幅居前，大金融、有色金属、农业、油气等板块跌幅居前。 3、两市共605只个股上涨，40只个股涨停，4567只个股下
text_en: 1. The market rebounded after probing lows throughout the day, with the three major indices all adjusting. The MLCC concept strengthened against the trend, with Shuangxing New Material and Fenghua Advanced Technology hitting the daily limit. PCB concept stocks were active, with Shennan Circuits, Chaosheng Electronics, and Xiehe Electronics hitting the daily limit. The military sector pulled up during the session, with Inner Mongolia First Machinery and Galaxy Electronics hitting the daily limit. On the downside, the large financial sector fell, with Xinli Financial and Cuiwei shares hitting the daily limit, and Jinlong shares nearing the limit-down. More stocks fell than rose, with nearly 4,900 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets closing lower, and turnover today at 1.99 trillion yuan. By the close, the Shanghai Composite fell 1.18%, the Shenzhen Component fell 1.08%, and ChiNext fell 0.49%. 2. By sector and concept, MLCC, military, copper high-speed connectivity, and film and television led gains, while large financials, nonferrous metals, agriculture, and oil and gas led declines. 3. Across the two markets, 605 stocks rose, 40 hit the daily limit, and 4,567 fell
